prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Specify scrolling and nested content in an iPhone itinerary. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS. Three nested vertical scrollers trap movement, content has no end affordance and a sticky booking action obscures the final stop. Pulling near the edge triggers navigation unexpectedly; text can enlarge.

criteria.task_completion: Choose a coherent scrolling hierarchy, visible content/position cues and unobscured endpoints with accessible large-text traversal; distinguish horizontal subcontent from conflicting same-axis scrolling.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the scroll-views guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Choose a coherent scrolling hierarchy, visible content/position cues and unobscured endpoints with accessible large-text traversal; distinguish horizontal subcontent from conflicting same-axis scrolling.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
